Use Franklin Navigator responsibly

Terms & information limits

Franklin Navigator provides independent, linked to original sources community guidance. It is not a government agency or a substitute for professional or emergency help.

Verify current details

Hours, eligibility, boundaries, requirements, credentials, services and availability can change. Confirm time-sensitive information with the linked official or first-party source.

No endorsement or affiliation

A listing or link does not mean Franklin Navigator endorses, recommends, ranks or is affiliated with that person or organization unless expressly stated.

Professional and emergency matters

The site is not legal, medical, financial or emergency advice. Call 911 for an active emergency and use an appropriate professional or responsible agency when needed.

Third-party websites

External websites control their own content, availability, privacy and terms. Franklin Navigator is not responsible for actions taken on those sites.

Respectful use

Do not misuse listings for harassment, unlawful outreach, deception, scraping that violates source terms, or claims of affiliation that do not exist.
